help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: We're here to help. Find answers below or reach out to our support team.
help.faq1A: Start by describing your symptoms. Our AI will conduct a health interview, then a licensed doctor reviews your case and provides a medical report with diagnosis and treatment plan.
help.faq2Q: How much does a consultation cost?
help.faq2A: Consultations cost 3 tokens by default. You can purchase token packages from the Wallet tab.
help.faq3Q: How long until I get my report?
help.faq3A: Most reports are completed within 24 hours. Complex cases may take up to 48 hours.
help.faq4Q: Can I request a specific doctor?
help.faq4A: Yes! During the intake process, you can select a preferred doctor or let the system auto-assign one.
help.faq5Q: How do I request a refund?
help.faq5A: Go to the consultation detail page and tap 'Request Refund'. Our admin team will review your request within 24 hours.
help.faq6A: Yes. All data is encrypted and stored securely. We comply with healthcare data protection regulations.
